AKJCL 52W high is 431.80. If accumulation continues, 431.80 is the next resistance with potential for new highs. RSI 64.95 (bullish), ADX 33.19 (strong trend), Aroon 100% (maximum momentum), MACD bearish crossover is a lagging signal here. The MACD bearish signal suggests prior weakness but Aroon 100% and RSI 65 with ADX 33 strongly indicate new uptrend initiation. The key difference: MABEL has fresh momentum with RSI at 66 (not 84 like BUNGAL), and ADX 22 vs 74 — MABEL still has room to run vs BUNGAL which is near exhaustion. Watch RSI: if MABEL RSI approaches 75+, reassess. For now, B58 buying + RSI 67 + Aroon 100% = continuation signal.

keyInsights.title: MARKET RECOVERY OUTLOOK — B58 BACK AS NET BUYER +Rs.185.4M AFTER -Rs.211.7M SELL SESSION
keyInsights.body: After selling net -Rs.211.7M on May 21, B58 reversed sharply to NET BUYER +Rs.185.4M on May 22. This V-shaped reversal (buy Rs.431.3M, sell Rs.245.9M) confirms: (1) May 21 sell was tactical distribution in FMDBL/SBI/ULHC/LICN — not broad market exit, (2) May 22 buying in AKJCL/RIDI/CREST/MABEL/NHPC/API/SAHAS represents new accumulation targets. The market responded with NEPSE +16.38 pts (+0.59%), breadth 203/57/8, turnover Rs.4.50B — all positive signals. KEY WATCH for May 25: does B58 sustain buying above Rs.200M? If yes, AKJCL/RIDI/CREST/MABEL are the priority holds. If B58 turns net seller again, protect capital — May 21 distribution in high-concentration stocks was a warning.
